title: cascarilla oblongifolia
intro: Cascarilla oblongifolia, commonly known as Sweet Woodruff or Cascarilla, is a perennial plant native to Central and South America. The plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include the ability to reduce anxiety and promote relaxation, as well as its potential to lower blood pressure and alleviate insomnia. The bioactive constituents of Cascarilla oblongifolia include essential oils, flavonoids, and tannins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including sedative, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. Overall, the plant has been used to support cardiovascular health, improve sleep quality, and soothe digestive issues.
